response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), regional_counts AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM district_counts), above_average AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, region_avg FROM regional_counts WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS exceeds_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio FROM above_average ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
